name: SWEL 5318
title: Core Concepts of Child and Adolescent Trauma
description: Incorporates the new National Child Traumatic Stress Network core curriculum on child trauma (CCCT). The course conveys the crucial evidence-based concepts, components, and skills designed by the NCTSN to strengthen competency in assessment, referral, and treatment.
requirement_description: Open to Social Work MSW and non-degree students.
